Sorry, there is only the output I posted. 

I have run through several samples and have experienced two errors. One error is the one which I described, which only seems to happen when using fastq files that only had one chromosome in them (btw if I run sequenz-utilis giving on that chromosome as the -C it works fine), but it would be nice not to have to worry about giving the right list of chromosomes for each sample.

The other error seems to happen when I am comparing a normal which came from WES and a tumor which came from a cancer panel. In that case, I get the error posted here: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/sequenza-user-group/Kqy4qV6TfXU

Thanks.
